name: DVGO (Deep Voxel Grids)
definition: A hybrid implicit-explicit representation that speeds up NeRF by replacing the density MLP with voxel grids, using implicit representation for color inference and explicit for density inference.
summary: DVGO is a fast radiance field method that accelerates NeRF by using explicit voxel grids for density and implicit MLPs for color, enabling real-time volume rendering.
